text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I try to stay consistent. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After a quick breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work on my computer until lunchtime, and then I continue with meetings and emails in the afternoon. Around five o'clock, I go to the gym or run in the park for about an hour. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I go to bed before eleven to make sure I get enough sleep.
